IMPLEMENTED
- Explicit Nikon / Fujifilm X-T20 experimental selection in Wi-Fi connection page.
- Separate saved endpoints and editable drafts; old Nikon migration preserved.
- Dedicated Fuji TCP/PTP initialization, strict actual ACK X-T20 model gate,
  remote-channel/gallery negotiation, event polling, virtual storage/indices,
  JPEG metadata/thumbnail reads and bounded 1 MiB partial-object downloads.
- Selected Wi-Fi route applies to command and fixed auxiliary ports 55741/55742.
- Exact transaction, packet bounds, size, chunk and JPEG completion checks.
- No public shutter, camera-delete, generic property-write or preset-write API.
- Fuji live start/resume and Nikon preset handoff refused before side effects.
- Existing downloaded JPEG saving and mobile preset flows reused.
- RAF, video, USB photo transfer and Fuji photo live are not implemented.

EXISTING UNRELATED FAILURE
The full run-probe.ps1 USB-import fixture fails at
UsbPictureControlImportHostTest.ncpConversionAndOccupiedTargetsNeverBypassTheGuards,
fake camera expectedWrite byte-array mismatch (line 526, invoked at line 285).
The same test was rerun with original HEAD PtpIpClient taking classpath precedence
and failed identically; USB transport/import/fixture files were not changed here.
The read-only probe 685 and PictureControl 453 checks passed before that failure;
the Nikon wireless wrapper was run independently and passed as listed above.
The full probe suite is NOT represented as passing.

LIMITS / NOT VERIFIED
- No real X-T20 connection, actual JPEG transfer, pixel comparison, RAF, throughput,
  physical-shutter availability, long connection, lockscreen, Doze or power test.
- No Android native UI acceptance this round. Emulator start escalation review
  timed out twice; a workspace-configured restricted read-only launch exited
  before Android boot. No emulator screenshot or native UI result is claimed.
- Host camera substitutes validate sequencing and failure containment; they do
  not prove compatibility with the user's firmware and Wi-Fi environment.
- Official X-T20 Camera Remote support proves wireless import is available, not
  continuous physical-shutter tether shooting. Fuji photo live remains disabled.
- The adapter's DeviceInfo and storage/handle datasets are locally mapped views
  of Fuji protocol facts, not a claimed camera-provided standard GetDeviceInfo.
- Initialization and download sequence follow maintained libfuji/libpict sources;
  final compatibility needs a true X-T20 test.

USE
Settings -> Wi-Fi wireless connection -> Camera type -> Fujifilm X-T20 (experimental)
Camera -> Shooting settings or Playback menu -> Wireless communication
Default endpoint: 192.168.0.1:55740. Confirm the phone on the camera.
See docs/fujifilm-x-t20.md for Chinese instructions, exact scope and source links.
